Fresh research supports Green Transportation Leasing, LLC as the historical legal platform for the 2018 Generate/BYD electric-bus leasing program, but it does not establish a current member schedule, either party's current equity status or percentage, Generate's fund or account, or a current qualifying lease and vehicle-title book. The existing rename and ownership correction therefore remain unsafe.
